description: a / (a + b) × 100 rounded half up to a whole number; 50 when neither has a vote. Other choices are ignored.
expression: (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))) == 0 ? 50 : (200 * size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b")))) / (2 * (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))))
name: option a share
rounding: half up to a whole percent

description: 100 minus option a's share, so the two always add to 100; 50 when neither has a vote.
expression: (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))) == 0 ? 50 : 100 - (200 * size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b")))) / (2 * (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))))
name: option b share

description: Count the votes per choice. Start from a = 0 and b = 0, set each choice that has votes to its count, and send the object as a JSON string. A choice other than a or b is added after a and b in the order the count returns it; the expression covers only a and b.
name: standing counts

description: The votes for a plus the votes for b: 'No votes yet' when none, '1 vote' for one, otherwise the number followed by ' votes'. Other choices are not counted.
expression: (size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))) == 0 ? "No votes yet" : ((size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b"))) == 1 ? "1 vote" : string((size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "a")) + size(Vote.filter(k, Vote[k].choice == "b")))) + " votes")
name: total votes label

description: The voter_id the browser sent when it is present and not empty; otherwise 64 random bits written in lower-case hexadecimal with the last digit dropped (so at most 15 digits, fewer when it starts with zeros).
name: voter identifier
